matching_rule: Normalize lowercase alphanumeric tokens, treating punctuation, spaces, and underscores as separators. Search the concatenated root_cause_class and explanation for any case-specific alias as a contiguous normalized phrase. Alias sets are based only on the frozen case ground truth and source facts, not model outputs. Unmatched paraphrases are not automatically accepted; this is a deterministic string rubric, not an automated semantic judge.
case_level_rule: A case passes a condition when at least 3 of 5 seed-level primary scores pass.
